snippet.title: Void Nebula - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Create, customize and fuse every card in this sci-fi roguelite deckbuilder where you battle foes, stack absurd items, and drag your handmade deck to the heart of the Nebula. 

Get ready to play the demo during Steam Next Fest in October!

WISHLIST NOW : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4212830/Void_Nebula/
